title: Import nginx config
intro: Paste server blocks, or run the command below on the nginx host and paste the full output (it includes the files pulled in by include). You can review the result before importing; domains that already exist are skipped.
certMissing: No certificate covers these domains yet: {domains}
certFiles: (nginx uses {files}; you can add it on the Certificates page by file path)
enableNowHelp: Sites and new listeners take effect immediately. If nginx still holds the same port, the new listener fails to start; stop nginx first, then enable it.
disabledHelp: Imported sites and new listeners stay disabled so you can review them one by one before enabling, which suits running alongside nginx during migration.
